programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Filmed entirely in the Philippines, "Platoon" tells us about the year a young university student named Chris spends in a regiment, who decides to volunteer in the Vietnam War. First part of a trilogy directed and written by Oliver Stone about the Vietnam War (followed by Born on the Fourth of July and Between Heaven and Earth). The protagonist of this story is a young Charlie Sheen, accompanied by a cast among which we highlight Willem Dafoe, Tom Berenger or some at that time still unknown Forest Whitaker or Johnny Depp. "Platoon" was the first film about Vietnam written and directed by a veteran of that war. Oliver Stone created this masterpiece taken from the experiences that he himself lived on the battlefield in his year as a soldier, filming almost a documentary where he tells us in first person through a character named Chris all his experiences in Vietnam. We are thus witnessing one of the most precise and realistic war films that recount this conflict with excellent direction, a script and impeccable editing. As for the exteriors, they are very well detailed and this perfection makes the viewer quickly immerse themselves in the war atmosphere that surrounds everything without rest. Definitely, a spectacular film that shows what until then Hollywood always tried to hide and the best way to get closer to what those days in Vietnam really were. Classic of the eighties and universal cinema.

programme.title: Zooloco

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: MI6 agent Ray Koval (Clive Owen) is in Dubai when he meets Claire Stenwick (Julia Roberts). After groping her a little, he manages to win her over and they spend the night together, without knowing that Claire is part of the CIA. When Ray wakes up the next day, the woman has disappeared with several compromised documents. For years, Ray searches for her, leaves his job at MI6 and gets a new one in the espionage department of a large multinational. In his third week of work he meets Claire again. Now they both work as spies for large companies and Claire is not willing to allow anyone to come and destroy the professional future she has been building for just over a year. The two spies will use all kinds of tricks to keep their positions, but they will also have to fight against the great attraction they feel for each other so as not to succumb to the other person's deceptions. In this film, actor Clive Owen plays MI6 spy Ray Koval. Owen began his career in television, working mainly on not very well-known series. Currently, although he still makes some stellar appearances on television, he is one of the best-known faces on the big screen. He has worked in films such as 'The Bourne Affair', 'King Arthur' and 'Closer' where he shares the bill for the first time with actress Julia Roberts. In 'Duplicity', Roberts plays Claire Stenwick, a retired CIA agent. The acclaimed actress began her career in 1987, in the series 'The History of Crime'. After that she worked in several films until she gained fame through 'Pretty Woman' and her starring role alongside actor Richard Gere. From there her career took off and her charming smile made her 'America's Sweetheart'. He played several leading roles in romantic comedies but he has always tried to combine it with more serious roles such as those he played in 'Stay by me' or 'Erin Brockovich'.

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: Young JR is accused and imprisoned for a minor crime. When he enters prison he discovers the harshness of life in prison, but he will soon become the protégé of Brendan Lynch, one of the most dangerous prisoners in Australia. However, that protection will have a price and Lynch, along with his team, will have plans for JR when he is released from prison: help them with their escape plan.

programme.title: The jury
programme.desc: A young New Orleans widow files a civil lawsuit against a powerful corporate consortium whom she blames for her husband's death. Thus, a multimillion-dollar case is launched. Judicial thriller based on a novel by John Grisham, a best-selling writer who is well versed in all the ins and outs of United States law.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Texas. Two years before the American Civil War breaks out. King Schultz is a German bounty hunter who is tracking murderers to collect for their heads, and he promises the black slave Django to set him free on the condition that he helps him catch them. Django accepts, since his greatest wish is to go rescue his wife Broomhilda, a slave who is on the plantation of landowner Calvin Candie. This film, written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a western film with references to the spaghetti western genre; genre through which I wanted to portray a story about slavery like this one. Tarantino is a renowned American director, producer and screenwriter whose films are characterized by addressing non-linear stories, violence, Grindhouse influences, kung fu and spaghetti westerns. Starring Jamie Foxx ('Bait', 'Collateral'), Christoph Waltz ('Inglourious Basterds', 'Dorian'), Leonardo DiCaprio ('Titanic', 'The Great Gatsby') and Samuel L. Jackson ('S.W.A.T.', 'Star Wars'); The film is a mix of good dialogue, rhythm, irony, and an impeccable soundtrack that allows it to capture the viewer's attention at all times.

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Agent 47 has been genetically engineered to become an effective and lethal hitman, working under instructions from a mysterious group known as 'The Organization'. However, when he finds himself involved in a political conspiracy that is beyond his understanding, he will turn against what he has known until now to try to find out who has set him up. While Interpol and the Russian army search for him throughout Europe, the murderer will have to face two new elements in his life: conscience and love.

programme.title: Hitman. Agent 47
programme.desc: Based on the famous video game, Hitman is an elite assassin who has been genetically modified to become a perfect killing machine. Identified only by a barcode that he has tattooed, his target is a corporation that aims to reveal his past and create assassins more powerful than him.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker is a young man who studies in high school and lives with his Aunt May. But in addition to all the problems that a teenager his age can have, Peter's life hides something totally unusual, and that is that he combines his ordinary teenage life with the identity of the famous superhero Spider-Man. After having fought alongside the Avengers to save New York City, Peter returns to his Aunt May's house, where he will try to resume his routine while being trained by his mentor Tony Stark to become an Avenger and fight crime. The adaptation will not be easy and soon a new villain known as The Vulture will burst onto the scene, whom Spider-Man will have to defeat.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: When they investigate a cyclone that has devastated a Mexican town, Nick Furia and Maria Hill are surprised by an unknown superhero. In New York, Peter Parker tries to adapt to life after 'The Gap' and the disappearance of his mentor.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With Spider-Man's identity revealed, Peter turns to Doctor Strange for help. Something goes wrong and the multiverse becomes the biggest threat to the world. Now Peter must discover what it really means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Godzilla is the remake of a 1954 Japanese film called Goiira. In this remake, the film focuses heavily on the people affected by the case, not just the beast. Dr. Nick Tatopoulos is sent to Panama with a group of soldiers to investigate the causes of the destruction of a Japanese ship in the Pacific. There he finds remains of the skin of an animal unknown in the world of science and they believe that they are a mutation resulting from nuclear tests& The giant lizard, whose appearance in this American remake is far from the original Japanese appearance, crosses the ocean and heads to New York, there, in addition to frightening society and causing serious damage, it is attacked by the military forces with missiles from helicopters among other methods, but the beast seems implacable. The effects necessary to give the animal realism cost around 50 million dollars. The film had a total cost of 120 million dollars. Nick, thanks to a blood sample that he managed to take from the animal, discovers that it is a hermaphrodite that collects food for himself and his offspring& This complicates things& The event is followed worldwide and Audrey Timmonds, ex-wife of scientist Nick, steals a video tape from Panama to benefit her journalistic career, which at the same time will bring serious problems for Nick. This film is just one of the many works that came from the original Japanese idea, whose mark is present in video games, comics or animated series.

programme.title: what a couple of cops
programme.desc: Two police officers are looking for a very expensive baseball card from 1952. They must rescue a Mexican supermodel and put an end to a drug organization.

programme.title: Crank: High voltage
programme.desc: Hitman Chelios faces off against a Chinese gangster who has stolen his virtually indestructible heart and replaced it with a sophisticated battery-powered device that requires frequent bursts of electricity to continue functioning.

programme.title: Demolition
programme.desc: A successful executive struggles to understand his emotional disconnection after the sudden and tragic death of his wife in a car accident. Despite his father-in-law's pressure to recover, Davis remains bewildered and reflects this by compulsively disassembling increasingly conspicuous objects around him.

programme.title: A doctor in the countryside
programme.desc: After 30 years working as the only doctor in a small village in a rural area of ​​southern France, Jean-Pierre falls ill. Health problems remove the doctor who attended, cured and cared for his neighbors from the profession 365 days a year and at any time. That is why it is necessary for another person to move in to replace him during sick leave. At that moment, Nathalie, a young doctor who has just finished her residency and who also has extensive experience as a nurse, arrives in the village. She will be in charge of helping Pierre with his work when he can't, but it will be a professional challenge because she has never worked in a medical office in a small town. In this way, it will also be complicated for Jean-Pierre because for him his work is the most important thing, so he will have to learn to deal with his new partner.

programme.title: Better... impossible
programme.desc: Melvin Udall is a novelist with obsessive-compulsive disorder that, among other things, causes him to walk down the street without stepping on sidewalk lines or to use new cutlery every time he eats. But Melvin is also proud of his ability to offend and irritate others, especially his neighbor Simon Nye, a homosexual artist whom the writer always attacks with his viperous tongue. Melvin has breakfast every day in a cafeteria and there is only one waitress who can put up with him, Carol, a single mother struggling to raise her asthmatic son. The fate of these characters will be intertwined because of a dog and a trip.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: The Edge
programme.desc: Second part of Charlie's Angels. Dylan, Natalie and Alex are sent by their boss on a new mission: locate a group of rings that have been stolen from the Department of Justice. This device allows its owner to know the list of people who are in the FBI's Witness Protection Program. When the first witnesses begin to appear dead, the Angels will have to use all their ingenuity to solve the case. An exceptional cameo can be seen in this film: one of the original Angels, Jaclyn Smith.

programme.title: Spider-Man: a new universe
programme.desc: After being bitten by a spider and acquiring superpowers, teenager Miles Morales dedicates himself to leading a double life in which he combines his high school routine with patrolling the city and chasing villains.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Crossing the Multiverse
programme.desc: Traveling through the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-Man, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes disagree over how to confront a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker was abandoned by his parents when he was still a child, and was raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Somewhat marginalized at school, Peter wants to know his past and find out who he is, but there he meets his first love, Gwen Stacy. When Peter discovers a briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a quest to learn how his parents disappeared, something that will take him to Oscorp and the laboratory of his father's former partner, Dr. Connor, where he is bitten by an experimentally modified spider that gives him incredible powers. The murder of his uncle by a thief will make him seek revenge, catching the criminals he finds in his path, so he realizes that his destiny is to help people. But Dr. Connor, in turn, is forced to test his own experiment (a lizard serum that regenerates body limbs) on himself after his dismissal, which turns him into The Lizard. This will spread panic among the citizens, and Peter will be forced to use his powers. It is the first film of a cinematographic reboot of this character, since due to script problems Sony had canceled the fourth installment of Spider-Man, opting for this reboot. Marc Webb is in charge of directing the film, and he specializes in the world of music videos, in which groups such as Green Day, My Chemical Romance, Evanescence, Maroon 5 and Fergie have featured him. His only films are (500) Days Together and the first and second installment of this new Spider-Man saga. Andrew Garfield plays Peter Parker. He began in theater and acted in Leones por Corderos and the television film Boy A, which gave him recognition; just like his performance in The Social Network. Emma Stone plays Gwen Stacy, and participated in films such as Campus Bunny, Ghosts of My Ex-Girlfriends, Crazy, Stupid, Love or Entitled to Friction. His role in Easy A earned him a Golden Globe nomination.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2: El poder de Electro
programme.desc: Peter Parker leads a very busy life: he has to save the city from bad guys and also continue with his university life to take care of Gwen, although from a distance. Things get complicated when the villain Electro appears with a thirst for revenge. However, it won't be the only thing Peter has to face, as the return of an old friend, Harry Osborn, brings new clues about his past.

programme.title: Life at stake
programme.desc: The film delves into the story of Sean Porter, Camp Kilpatrick juvenile detention camp probation officer and retired player, and his partner, Officer Malcolm Moore, who turned a group of dangerous juvenile delinquents into the Camp Kilpatrick Mustangs football team, having a fantastic season in 1990 and reaching the regional championship final against the Montclair Prep High School team. Porter will teach the boys to go against gang rivalries and bitter hatreds between peers, and both he and the young men will learn difficult lessons about life while the boys also acquire a sense of responsibility and self-respect.

programme.title: Point Break (Sin límites)
programme.desc: Remake of the film 'They Call Him Bodhi', directed in 1991 by Kathryn Bigelow ('The Darkest Night'). Johnny, a young FBI agent, infiltrates a team of elite athletes led by Boshi. Johnny's mission is to discover if the gang is behind a series of deaths and unusual robberies that are causing the world economy to plummet. Therefore, covertly and trying not to discover his true identity, the agent will have to risk his life to find evidence that will allow him to incriminate the gang and capture it. However, when he begins to form a friendship with the leader, Johnny will question whose side he is on and what he should do.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, the team's commander, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: 22 Balas
programme.desc: A former member of the mafia who has been retired for three years, living a peaceful life dedicated to his wife and children, is attacked one morning by some men and left for dead after receiving 22 bullets. However, after miraculously surviving, he begins searching for Tony Zacchia, the only man capable of daring to kill him. Tony has made only one mistake: failing in his attempt...

According to the Mayan calendar, the year 2012 is set as the date of the end of the world. This end of the world will bring different natural disasters, volcanoes will erupt, there will be major floods, typhoons... Jackson Curtis (John Cusack) is a writer of science fiction stories who also works as a driver for a Russian millionaire. Jackson is divorced and has two children, Lilly (Morgan Lily) and Noah (Liam James) who live with his ex-wife's boyfriend. One day, when Jackson and his children return home they find that great seismic activity is affecting the entire West Coast of the United States. Suddenly the Curtis family will find themselves immersed in a fight to survive what could be the end of the world. Actor John Cusack, known for his performance in films such as '1408' (2007), 'High Fidelity' (2000) and 'How to Be John Malkovich' (1999), stars in this feature film about the consequences of the end of the world that the Mayans predicted would happen in 2012. Its director, Roland Emmerich, specialized in action films and apocalyptic and disaster films, confirmed the film's completion. of a television series, a sequel to the feature film, which would be based on the survivors of the disaster. An alternative ending to the film was also included in some versions of the DVD marketed in different countries. For its promotion, a trailer was used in which you could see how a tsunami threatened the Himalayas, ending with the phrase 'The governments of the world did not prepare the people for the end of the world, find out the truth.' The page of the fictitious organization 'Institute for Human Continuity' was also launched, thus beginning an important viral marketing strategy.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker is a young man who studies in high school and lives with his Aunt May. But in addition to all the problems that a teenager his age can have, Peter's life hides something totally unusual, and that is that he combines his ordinary teenage life with the identity of the famous superhero Spider-Man. After having fought alongside the Avengers to save New York City, Peter returns to his Aunt May's house, where he will try to resume his routine while being trained by his mentor Tony Stark to become an Avenger and fight crime. The adaptation will not be easy and soon a new villain known as The Vulture will burst onto the scene, whom Spider-Man will have to defeat.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: When they investigate a cyclone that has devastated a Mexican town, Nick Furia and Maria Hill are surprised by an unknown superhero. In New York, Peter Parker tries to adapt to life after 'The Gap' and the disappearance of his mentor.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With Spider-Man's identity revealed, Peter turns to Doctor Strange for help. Something goes wrong and the multiverse becomes the biggest threat to the world. Now Peter must discover what it really means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker is a shy young student. He has never had much confidence in himself and although he is very intelligent, except for his best friend, the rich Harry Osborn, he has no friends. He has been in love with his beautiful redhead neighbor for years: Mary Jane, but he would never find the courage to propose to her. Meanwhile, he lives in a small neighborhood in the New York borough of Queens with his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. His life will change forever when, during a visit to a laboratory, a radioactive spider bites him, causing changes in him that at first seem frightening but will soon make him feel as if he had spider superpowers: he has colossal strength, he can climb walls and ceilings and he can also create spider webs with his hands. With his new powers, Peter becomes more daring. He no longer needs glasses and has acquired muscles that make him very attractive. At school he saves Mary Jane from falling in the cafeteria and accidentally throws food at a bully named "Flash." When he is about to hit him, Peter manages to neutralize him and impresses his friends and the girl of his dreams. To try to win him over, she lies to her Uncle Ben by saying she is going to the library but actually entering a wrestling contest for $3,000. With the money he intends to buy a second-hand sports car for Mary Jane. But when he wins the fight he discovers that the manager does not intend to pay him. Snubbed, he goes out to the street to find his uncle dying on the ground: a thief has shot him to take the car. In his arms, the one who was like a father to him dies. Peter will now become "Spiderman" and use a costume to take revenge on criminals who destroy families like his. Soon his first enemy will appear: The Green Goblin. The Green Goblin was chosen as the villain of this film since director Sam Raimi felt that the father-son duel would make the film more interesting.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Two years ago Peter Parker decided to accept his responsibility as Spider-Man and put his personal life aside; within which enter his great love Mary Jane Watson and his friend Harry Osborn, who feels a desire for revenge against Spider-Man for the death of his father. Peter's relationship with both of them is increasingly deteriorating. Peter's friend and role model, Dr. Otto Octavius ​​begins experimenting with fusion energy funded by the current president of Oscorp, who is Harry Osborn. But accidentally, the experiment becomes unstable, so his robotic arms fuse to his spine and he loses control, becoming the villainous Dr. Octopus. Despite this conflict with Octavius, Peter faces the emotional distress caused by knowing that his love Mary Jane is engaged to another man. This makes him think about what his life would be like without having to fight crime, so he will be forced to choose between his personal life as a student and his public obligations. Directed by Sam Raimi, it is the second film in the Marvel superhero saga made by this director, who is also known for his low-budget horror films such as "The Evil Dead" trilogy. He also produced television series such as "Hercules: His Legendary Journeys" or "Xena: Warrior Princess." Tobey Maguire plays Peter Parker in this first Spider-Man trilogy, who made his film debut with "This Boy's Life" and starred in films such as "Pleasantville", "Seabiscuit" and "The Great Gatsby". Kirsten Dunst plays Mary Jane Watson. This actress, model and singer was recognized at the age of 12 for her portrayal of a vampire in "Interview with the Vampire." He also participated in "Jumanji", "The Virgin Suicides" by Sofia Coppola and "Marie Antoinette". James Franco plays Harry Osborn, who began in the series "Freaks & Geeks" and participated in films such as "Milk" or "127 Hours."

programme.desc: An AI-generated actor called Tilly Norwood has been cast in the lead role of a forthcoming film, adding to the debate about artificial intelligence in filmmaking. The announcement follows criticism from actors such as Emily Blunt, and objections from the US performers' union. Eline Van der Velden, founder and CEO of Particle6, explains why she created Tilly Norwood, while Jake Kanter, international investigations editor at Deadline, sets out the reaction from the film industry. Andy Burnham has become the UK's new prime minister, and his approach to the media is already attracting attention. His team has relied more on social media, online creators and direct communication than on traditional broadcast interviews. Lizzy Buchan, political editor of the Daily Mirror; Jennifer Gerber, senior political advisor, WA Communications; Tom Nicholas, creator of the Slow News Day YouTube channel; and broadcaster Andrew Neil, presenter of The Andrew Neil Report, assess what this could mean for political journalism and public accountability.

programme.title: Clive Myrie’s Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: For 11 months of the year, the city of La Vega is well off the tourist track. But each February, it bursts into life. Over the course of four weekends, it’s loud, hot and colourful as visitors from all over the world arrive to join in the famous street carnivals. Clive is in the party mood and throws himself into the fun. He stocks up on local sweet treats, meets talented mask makers and prepares outrageous costumes before joining the parade in full costume.

programme.title: On the Front Line
programme.desc: Myanmar's civil war has claimed almost 100 thousand lives. In 2021, the country's military seized power in a coup - and after losing ground to rebel and ethnic groups, it's making a renewed push - carrying out the forced-recruitment of tens of thousands of conscripts - and employing new drone technology. The United Nations' human rights spokesman has condemned the military's tactics which he's called brutal, and he's said that civilians are paying a terrible price. BBC correspondent, Quentin Sommerville and camera journalist Darren Conway have spent time with rebel groups. This films contains some graphic scenes, including surgery and childbirth.

programme.desc: The Economist's interview with Elon Musk attracted global attention before Musk then described interviewer Zanny Minton Beddoes as a 'traitor to the West'. programme.title: Ketemu Cinta Di Online Shop
programme.desc: Rayya adalah mahasiswa yang menekuni bisnis online. Dia mendapat saingan yaitu Pras, teman kampusnya yang juga punya bisnis toko online. Setelah kalah bersaing, Pras bekerja untuk Rayya, dan mereka saling jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Perjalanan Terlarang
programme.desc: Mala dan temannya merencanakan untuk berkemah di hutan belantara, tetapi Mala dilarang orang tuanya dan mereka tetap nekat. Sejak itu mereka terjebak di hutan yang jauh dari keramaian.

programme.title: Jubah Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Sinta, gadis cantik dan ambisius dari keluarga kurang mampu. Setelah menemukan Jubah Tak Kasat Mata di toko Kr. Amat, dia menyusup masuk ke rumah Poppy dan mencuri uang dari brankas. Tapi ternyata jubah tersebut membawa kutukan.

programme.title: Sepatu Roda Gila
programme.desc: Mike dan Thomas sama-sama ahli bermain sepatu roda. Sayangnya. geng mereka bermusuhan. Masalah semakin rumit saat Mike ditemukan tewas. Thomas menjadi tersangka utama atas pembunuhan itu. Apakah Thomas sungguh pembunuhnya?

programme.title: Terperangkap Di Alas Roban
programme.desc: Saat pulang dari liburan, bus yang ditumpangi Muham dan temannya mogok tepat di tengah wilayah angker. Mereka menolong seorang gadis yang ternyata disandera makhluk misterius di sana.

programme.title: Putri Keong Mas
programme.desc: Puteri diserahkan kepada seorang dukun oleh ibu tirinya yang sangat kejam. Sejak saat itu, puteri hidup sebagai keong emas, dan hanya bisa kembali sebagai manusia jika ada seorang pemuda yang jatuh cinta kepadanya.

programme.title: Manusia Ikan Jatuh Cinta
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya bangkrut, Risa terpaksa pindah ke sebuah kampung dekat laut. Di sana, saat dia nyaris tenggelam, tiba-tiba ada yang membawanya ke permukaan. Saat tersadar, dia hanya melihat sekilas manusia dengan sirip ikan.

programme.title: Factory Cinta
programme.desc: Karin melaksanakan tugas KKN di sebuah desa terpencil selama dua minggu. Merasa bosan, dia dan sahabatnya, Dinda, pergi ke kota untuk berbelanja tapi justru kemalingan dan tersesat. Lalu, Aman datang menyelamatkannya.

programme.title: The charm of Semar Mesem
programme.desc: Nirmala dulunya adalah gadis buruk rupa, tapi sejak menggunakan mustika semar mesem dia berubah cantik. Dia memanfaatkannya untuk membalas dendam kepada para pria yang pernah menolaknya. Namun kecantikannya harus dibayar mahal.

programme.title: Harta Karun Nenek Bajak
programme.desc: Putri mempunyai kekasih yang terlibat hutang bernama Draco. Saat sedang terdesak dia teringat bahwa dia memiliki kenalan bernama Mira yang memiliki nenek kaya raya bernama Nenek Bajak di kampungnya. Putri menipu Nenek Bajak.

programme.title: Married Failed
programme.desc: Jack seorang pencuri yang sedang menjadi buron. Suatu ketika ia merampok sebuah rumah dan mengambil satu peti mewah. Ia mengira itu adalah peti yang memuat perhiasan serta uang banyak. Apakah isi didalam peti tersebut?

programme.title: Rocking Penguin
programme.desc: Selvi dan Eriska yang dulunya bukan apa-apa namun sekarang menjadi sukses.Sayang sekali karier dan persahabatan mereka terganggu karena keduanya menyukai lelaki yang sama. Ternyata, lelaki tersebut telah dijodohkan dengan Eriska.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat : Teko 1001 Malam
programme.desc: Rani, cewek cupu yang dirundung teman-temannya dan kerap mendapat perlakuan buruk. Ia juga mendapat perlakuan kasar dari tantenya. Rani menemukan teko usang, ketika digosok keluar sosok jin yang bisa mengabulkan tiga permintaan.

programme.title: Punched by Love
programme.desc: Meskipun ibunya melarang, Indah tetap ingin menjadi seorang petinju. Saat sanggar tinju mengeluarkannya karena kesalahan pengisian data, Indah belajar kepada seorang rekan sesama petinju. Dan cinta tumbuh di antara mereka berdua.

programme.title: Ketukan Yang Mengancam
programme.desc: Aris, Novi dan Danu adalah sahabat dekat sejak SMP. Setelah tanpa sengaja menguping pembicaraan tentang meja kayu tua misterius di gudang sekolah yang bisa memanggil arwah, mereka berniat membuktikannya.

programme.title: Mirror World
programme.desc: Vuri adalah siswi SMA yang menjadi bahan olok-olok dan ketinggalan dalam pelajaran sekolah. Hingga dia menemukan sebuah cermin yang membawanya ke dunia lain yang keadaannya berbeda 180 derajat dengan dunianya sekarang.

programme.title: Jodoh Di Ujung Jari
programme.desc: Rio, cowok tampan playboy kampus, banyak cewek-cewek terpikat oleh Rio. Rio punya empat pacar dan harus bisa mengatur waktu dengan keempat pacarnya. Apakah akan berjalan dengan mulus?

programme.title: Jodoh Di Ujung Jari
programme.desc: Rio, cowok tampan playboy kampus, banyak cewek-cewek terpikat oleh Rio. Rio punya empat pacar dan harus bisa mengatur waktu dengan keempat pacarnya. Apakah akan berjalan dengan mulus?

programme.title: Saat Teduh Bersama Gereja Mawar Sharon
Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: Big Potato membuka sebuah klinik Tiongkok kuno, namun metode tradisionalnya ditolak oleh masyarakat Hong Kong modern yang skeptis. Ia meminta sahabatnya, Mr. Funnybone, untuk membantu menyelamatkan kliniknya.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: Ratu Kung-Fu asal Hong Kong, Cheng Pei-pei, berperan sebagai pendekar pedang wanita yang melakukan misi untuk membalas dendam atas kematian orangtuanya dan menyelamatkan negara dari penjajah asing.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai memerankan tokoh Pak Su-cheng, dewi ular nan mempesona yang memilih wujud sebagai seorang wanita sehingga ia dapat merasakan indahnya kehidupan manusia!

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: Qiao Miao hampir membunuh bandit yang baru saja ia temui, tapi ia tertarik dengan kecantikannya dan dengan cepat keduanya jatuh cinta. Kemudian, mereka terlibat dalam perseteruan antara pemilik senjata nan unik.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Perancang busana Shi tidak terima dengan kritik Mui kala memintanya untuk mengomentari desain barunya. Saat Mui memintanya untuk merancang gaun untuk menghadiri pesta, Shi membalas dendam dengan membuat kostum badut.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li meminta Wang, rekannya yang terpercaya untuk melindungi keluarganya saat ia pergi. Namun Wang memperkosa istrinya, membunuh pelayannya dan menyerang rombongan Li. Li khawatir jika putrinya masih berada dalam bahaya!

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: Dalam drama yang mengerikan ini, aktris populer Shaw Brothers, Li Jing, berperan sebagai putri pemilik penginapan di daerah pegunungan. Ia menyaksikan aksi pemerkosaan yang dilakukan oleh salah seorang penduduk.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: Seorang putri bangsawan diculik oleh bandit Golden Dragon Hill yang terkenal kejam. Seorang pendekar pedang bernama Yue Zhen Bei ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkannya, dan ia menghadapi banyak bahaya dalam perjalanannya.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai memerkosa Qiu Rong dan berjanji akan menikahinya usai mendapat persetujuan orang tuanya. Namun, tak ada kabar lagi tentang pernikahan tersebut. Qiu pun mendesak Liang Cai saat menyadari bahwa dirinya hamil.

programme.title: Call To Arms
programme.desc: Kekaisaran Chin yang agresif dan berbahaya menaklukkan kerajaan Chao yang tangguh, sementara kekaisaran Wei kehabisan pahlawan-pahlawannya dan lumpuh dipimpin penguasa yang tidak tegas.

programme.title: Asia-Pol
programme.desc: Agen Asiapol Yang Ming Xuan melacak suatu paket emas ilegal yang dikirim untuk ketua geng bernama George Eaton. Ia juga meminta bantuan seorang wanita Tiongkok yang ingin membalaskan dendam saudarinya.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar berbakat, Bo Hu, tertarik dengan seorang pelayan nan cantik, Qiu Xiang. Agar dapat mendekatinya dan memenangkan cintanya, ia menyamar sebagai seorang pelayan untuk bekerja di rumah yang sama.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Dalam drama peraih berbagai penghargaan arahan Li Han Hsiang ini, Betty Loh Ti berperan sebagai gadis cantik yang menyamar sebagai anak lelaki demi mendapatkan pendidikan yang terlarang bagi anak perempuan.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Kaisar tergila-gila pada Yang Gui Fei, selir kesayangannya, sehingga ia menyerahkan pemerintahan negara kepada Perdana Menteri. Namun, Perdana Menteri yang korup, membuat rakyat memberontak.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi Taiwan yang datang ke Hong Kong untuk mencari adiknya yang hilang. Ia hampir diperkosa oleh geng jalanan dan diselamatkan oleh seorang komposer tampan.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda bepergian ke Lembah Naga untuk menemui sahabat masa kecil yang dijanjikan untuk menjadi calon istrinya. Sesampainya di sana, ia menyadari bahwa keluarga sang mempelai wanita menyembunyikan banyak hal.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Ahli film laga Chang Cheh menceritakan kisah tentang Chin Feng yang bertemu dengan gadis cantik bernama Ting Hung saat tengah melarikan diri, setelah ia tak sengaja membunuh seorang pengganggu yang sombong.

programme.title: A Place To Call Home
programme.desc: Saat mengetahui jika dirinya adalah anak adopsi, Li Ching pergi untuk mencari keluarganya. Ketika situasi yang dialaminya menjadi semakin memburuk, ia akhirnya menyadari bahwa rumah adalah tempat yang terbaik.

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: Reuni dua teman SMA yang semula manis segera berubah menjadi mimpi buruk erotis yang mengerikan ketika Rose tertarik pada mantan teman sekelasnya, Fang, dan tunangan barunya!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi, seorang ahli kungfu gaya Hong Quan bekerja di pabrik tekstil yang direkomendasikan oleh Han, seniornya. Han memperingatkan Yi untuk tidak memamerkan keahlian seni bela dirinya agar tak mendapat masalah.

programme.title: Between Tears And Smiles
programme.desc: Kwan Shan harus menyelamatkan wanita yang ia cintai, sebelum wanita itu dipersembahkan sebagai hadiah untuk seorang Jenderal!

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Shek Kin, yang biasa berperan sebagai tokoh jahat, mengambil peran langka di film komedi tentang hantu lucu yang berteman dengan seorang anak lelaki dan membantu sang anak menyatukan kembali orangtuanya yang berseteru.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: Sebuah film yang berkisah tentang sebuah hubungan cinta nan rumit antara sekelompok anak muda yang terjerat dalam ikatan cinta dan emosi.

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang adalah putra pejabat pemerintah yang dihormati, sedangkan Sue San adalah seorang wanita penghibur nan terkenal. Meskipun dan terlihat cocok dan saling mencintai, keduanya sangat berbeda dalam tingkatan sosial.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Saat mobil yang ditumpangi sejumlah gadis berpapasan dengan mobil yang ditumpangi beberapa pria, Ching Li dan Paul Chin Pei jatuh cinta. Namun, kisah cinta mereka tidak berjalan mulus.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: Seorang gadis bersumpah akan membalas dendam atas kematian orang tuanya oleh empat penjahat saat ia masih bayi. Ia pun berlatih seni bela diri, serta bekerja sama dengan seorang pendekar pedang dan suatu pasangan.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: Pada masa kemunduran Dinasti Ching, putra dari hakim lokal membunuh seorang pedagang keliling dan memperkosa istrinya. Sang istri dijebak atas pembunuhan suaminya oleh sang pemerkosa.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Dokter Sing merasa bingung dengan gejala-gejala aneh yang dialami pasiennya dan meminta bantuan pada temannya. Penyakit tersebut rupanya disebabkan oleh ilmu hitam yang dilakukan oleh seorang pria jahat bernama Kong.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Bintang laga Chow Yun-Fat memerankan gangster sungguhan Chen Daqi saat ia naik ke eselon atas kekuasaan, mendapati dirinya terpecah antara cinta dua wanita, rencana pembunuhan dinas rahasia, dan ancaman perang yang membayangi.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box

When the body of dock worker Owen Thorne plummets from a multi-storey car park, DCI Vera Stanhope is forced to uncover a life of secrets and lies - everything points to foul play for Vera, but Thorne's wife Ellie insists that he was a good man and a loving father to their children. The team discover a dispute at work over the death of a young lad when a safety rig failed - everyone believes that Owen was to blame despite an inquest failing to find fault. The victim's father admits that he wanted revenge but his alibi holds - Vera then spots an inconsistency in Ellie's statement that suggests that she was less sure of her husband's fidelity than she is admitting. Aided by her team, Vera must use all her investigative skill and ingenuity to expose the truth behind Owen Thorne's death and ultimately stop his killer from claiming another victim.

programme.desc: Usai ditahbiskan, Pastor Do-woon mendengar pengakuan yang menguak hilangnya sang ibu 13 tahun lalu. Terbelenggu rahasia suci dan dendam, ia memilih memburu kebenaran.

programme.title: The Old Woman With The Knife
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh bayaran tua yang mahir menyingkirkan penjahat terburuk di masyarakat bertemu dengan seorang anak didik muda yang bersemangat untuk mempelajari keahlian tersebut. Saat mereka menjalin ikatan yang tak terduga, pembunuh veteran itu menemukan tujuan baru di masa senja hidupnya yang penuh kekerasan dan rutinitas.

programme.title: What A Man Wants
programme.desc: Berlatar di Pulau Jeju, What a Man Wants mengisahkan Seok-geun, seorang sopir taksi yang terkenal karena sifatnya yang genit meskipun telah menikah. Ia percaya bahwa romansa dan sensasi baru adalah bagian penting dalam hidup. Pandangan tersebut perlahan memengaruhi Bong-soo, adik iparnya yang setia kepada istrinya namun mulai tergoda oleh kehadiran perempuan lain. Ketika hubungan-hubungan rahasia dan berbagai godaan mulai memengaruhi kehidupan mereka, para tokoh harus menghadapi konsekuensi dari pilihan yang mereka buat. Dengan perpaduan komedi dan drama romantis, film ini membahas cinta, kesetiaan, pernikahan, dan dinamika hubungan orang dewasa secara ringan namun penuh makna.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: How do stunts work? What exactly does a stuntman do? Who are the real heroes of action films? The unique series “Stunt Heroes” on MotorvisionTV has been answering these and other questions for two years. The stunt people from Action Concept, one of the largest film and stunt productions in Europe, give a unique insight into their daily work and into what cannot be seen in the film. Weeks of preparation are often necessary for a 5-second film stunt. Backbreaking work! (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Martin Utberg visits the artist Andrew McGeachy in Thun, where he portrays an Alfa Romeo Montréal. In front of Schadau Castle, the viewer learns everything about the design and history of this iconic sports car. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Porsche now offers 27 derivatives of its cult model 911. The selection has never been so large. And it has never been possible to examine all models in one place until today! We are literally speed dating with the Porsche 911. Which variant can win the heart of Motorvision presenter Julian on a road trip through the Black Forest and the Palatinate and why? (Station info).

programme.title: A&E
programme.desc: The West Midlands Ambulance Service is called to millions of emergencies every year. The incidents are often so intense that treatment begins on the street. The team of dedicated doctors and paramedics has the daily task of saving lives. (Station info).

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: We test various tricycles for big boys: First, trikes with up to 200 hp car engines in the rear and the three-wheeled MP3 scooter from Piaggio, which has more grip than any other scooter with two front tires. (Station info).

programme.title: Mission Mobility
programme.desc: The Thomathal on the Katschberg in Austria - there is still calm here in the morning. The sun is shining, the ice is glittering. But the calm is over as soon as Danny Pfeil's European Speedclub begins winter driving training. Every January, an ordinary meadow is transformed into a treacherous course of ice and snow. Everyone can push their limits here for three weeks a year. (Station info).

programme.title: Isle of Man Tourist Trophy 2026
programme.desc: The Isle of Man Tourist Trophy is considered the toughest and most dangerous motorcycle race in the world, with riders reaching speeds of up to 200mph. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The new Bentley Continental GT. It is the successful model of the English luxury brand. Nevertheless, the British have been making losses in recent years. The new car must be a success in order to return Bentley to its former strength. This makes the development of the new Continental a particularly large, mammoth task. Made in England shows the development of the new GT and whether the luxury athlete also convinces racing legend Derek Bell. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.sub-title: Sustainability in mobility 1: Optimized combustion engines
programme.desc: Combustion engines have ensured our progress for 125 years. With the price of harmful emissions. In addition, the world population continues to grow and more and more cars are being sold. But this will only work for our earth/environment in the long term if vehicle emissions are drastically reduced at the same time. Green Wave – Sustainability in mobility shows developments as to how manufacturers want to further reduce the consumption of their vehicles in the future. (Station info).

programme.title: Dream Cars
programme.desc: They are the classic coupes, the English sports cars, cars as cool as James Bond. Aston Martin, Bentley and Jaguar build the most exclusive and elegant coupes in the world. Their inimitable design is still inspired today by the iconic Jaguar E-Type and Aston Martin DB5. Dream Cars presents the most exclusive and expensive English coupes. (Station info).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of sophisticated tin bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: He has a famous name and should heat up the Ferraris on the race track. The Bizzarrini GT 5300 from 1965. Giotto Bizzarrini, the creator of the famous Ferrari GTO, wanted to use this car to return the favor to his former employer Enzo Ferrari, because the employment relationship ended in a dispute. But the Italian super sports car with the American V8 heart failed spectacularly. Today, however, the Bizzarrini 5300 GT is a sought-after collector's item and is often more expensive than a Ferrari. (Station info).

programme.title: Cars + Life
programme.desc: The new mobile magazine presents the latest trends and innovations in the automotive industry every week. Whether compact everyday heroes, windy city runabouts for the urban jungle, beefy SUVs for family trips or modern electric and hydrogen vehicles: our experts will take you on a test drive through the world of automobility of today and tomorrow. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.sub-title: Mercedes – The comeback of the Silver Arrows
programme.desc: Whether gullwing, streamlined or monoposto – after the war, silver quickly became the color of the winners again. In the slipstream of their own myth, the second generation Silver Arrows also drive from victory to victory and give Mercedes golden years in racing. (Station info).

programme.title: Nordschleife
programme.desc: Racing legend Jackie Stewart once described the Nordschleife of the Nürburgring as a multi-limbed monster and gave it the name 'Green Hell'. The legendary track is also regularly accessible to the general public. Many “racers at heart” race through Schwedenkreuz, Fuchsrohre, Kesselchen and Karussell in their private cars. Once through the “Green Hell” a dream for many that no one has to stay. Nordschleife fans take the spectators on board and tell them what they associate with the ring. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Miriam Höller visits hot events and cool challenges in the motor world for Motorvision TV. In the first episode she reports on the "Night of the Jumps" in the Munich Olympic Hall. The event is part of the Night of the Jumps Tour, the official FIM World Motocross Championship. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: One of the top topics in this episode of Perfect Ride: topless models. With them, every adventure starts with a thrill: Spyder, Speedster, Roadster – in short: convertibles. Free driving and feeling of life in all variations (channel information).

programme.title: Rear view mirror
programme.desc: The highlights from all eras of automobile history: When the brand new Mercedes A-Class fell over in the moose test, when Stirling Moss won the Mille Miglia in record time, when Ferdinand Porsche amazed the world with an electric car in 1900. Exciting images show the viewer what really happened. Contemporary witnesses report on their experiences. In 1997 Ferrari celebrated the company's 50th birthday. At that time, Wolfgang Rother followed the Ferrari myth and collected his first driving impressions with the Ferrari 550 Maranello. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: Premium tuners and factory tuners: More and more horsepower, better and better sound, ever lower chassis, there are no limits. The finest tuning has to offer. Tips and tricks for lowering, repairing and pimping up. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Rollovers, ramp jumps, crashes – there are 1000 ways to destroy cars. They all know the Stunt Heroes! The report looks back at the car highlights of the last few months. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top speed presenter Martin Utberg and his teammate Jonas Lach are taking part in the Planai Classic, one of the few remaining real winter rallies in Europe. You start with an Austin Seven from 1932. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: English luxury and German lifestyle. With an extended wheelbase, the Bentley Bentayga focuses on its rear passengers and pampers them with flawless workmanship and a champagne cooler. In the Mercedes CLE 53, however, the best place is behind the steering wheel. Mercedes wants to arouse emotions again with a 3-liter in-line six-cylinder engine. (Station info).

programme.title: Road Wars Staffel 6
programme.desc: Drug crime, house searches, chases: Roadwars accompanies a special unit of the British police. Together with the dog team, they declare war on the thieves in the Thamse Vally. (Station info).

programme.title: NZ Jetsprint Championship 2025
programme.desc: The New Zealand Jetsprint Championship is the most important sprint boat competition from New Zealand, the country where the sport was founded in 1981. Jetsprinting is comparable to rally sports, but there is only one boat on the track at any given time and boats drive at very high speeds. The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Racing has been Ford's engine for over 100 years: Henry Ford won his first race with his first car. Thousands more victories are to follow as Ford writes motorsport history: the GT40 in Le Mans, the Capri on the circuit and the Escort in the Monte Carlos Rally and the Safari Rally. Ford professionalizes rallying, wins the Indianapolis 500 and builds the most successful engine in Formula 1, the Ford-Cosworth. Steering wheel geniuses like Jim Clark, Jackie Stewart and Carlos Sainz sit in the cockpit. Car History shows Ford's entire motorsport history, with exciting pictures from the wild (channel info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Moderator Martin Utberg takes the audience to the Klassikwelt Bodensee in Friedrichshafen, an event that is much more than a classic car fair. In addition to vintage and youngtimers, visitors can expect a varied program with demonstration drives of historic racing cars, an air show, a historic paddock and numerous encounters with collectors, racing drivers and enthusiasts. Top Speed ​​discovers why the Klassikwelt Bodensee is one of the most diverse classical events in Europe. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: After Carl Lewis appeared in award-winning commercials for Pirelli for two years, multiple Olympic champion Marie-Jo Peréc followed in his footsteps. A new masterpiece was shot around the world. Classic was there during the filming. programme.title: Car History
programme.sub-title: Audi – The story of the four rings
programme.desc: It is one of the most successful automobile manufacturers of today: Audi. The brand with the four rings stands for innovation, superior technology and unique design. Founded over 100 years ago, Audi is now a successful global company, with more than 1 million Audis sold every year. (Station info).

programme.title: Rear view mirror

programme.title: Racing Files
programme.desc: The Monaco Grand Prix was neither the first Grand Prix in motorsport history nor the first race to be held on a road circuit. Nevertheless, the event has achieved cult status since its premiere in 1929. No race is as intertwined with racing history as the Monaco Grand Prix. MOTORVISION TV tells the story of this legendary race. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Races

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: He was one of the most important automobile racing drivers of his time and largely influenced the motorsport era of the 50s and 60s. He was fast, brave, a real racer. Despite a few spectacular accidents, the 83-year-old is still cheerful and in good health today. In total, it took part in 261 races and reached the top of the podium 79 times. It is the unforgettable racing legend Hans Herrmann. (Station info).
